description: This Java class provides descriptors for Android XML DOM elements within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, including icon retrieval and element description logic.

classes.name: AndroidDomElementDescriptorProvider
classes.description: Provides XML element descriptors for Android DOM elements in IntelliJ IDEA plugin.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Returns an XML element descriptor for a given DOM element and XML tag, considering Android-specific annotations and hierarchy.

methods.name: getDomElementAndBaseClassQName
methods.description: Retrieves the Android DOM element and its associated base class name for a given XML tag.

methods.name: getIconForTag
methods.description: Returns an icon for a specific XML tag within an Android layout view context.

methods.name: getIconForViewTag
methods.description: Retrieves the icon associated with a specific Android view tag name.

methods.name: getInitialViewTagName2IconMap
methods.description: Initializes the mapping of view tag names to their corresponding icons.
